# UAT battery

Run this battery on every reviewed Preview slice. This replaces the factory scenarios from the earlier UAT branch with direct repository work and eve native delegation; it preserves triage, attachment, queue, cancellation, and repository-selection coverage. Follow [EXECUTOR-PREVIEW.md](./EXECUTOR-PREVIEW.md) first. Record current branch, commit SHA, deployment ID, connector trigger, test time, session IDs, Slack links, and observed results. Use the live-verified Preview bot and channel, not copied historical identifiers.

Use recent read-only cases selected by ID, dated when selected, and designated synthetic records for any allowed writes. Never use a customer record merely to test a permission. A previously passing behavior that now fails blocks the slice. Build success, `eve info`, and a model claim of success are insufficient: inspect actual action results and deployed logs. Evals cost real tokens; scratch delivery creates a branch and PR.

ENG-13737 acceptance scope, approved 2026-09-12: repeat repository-delivery checks are waived and live scheduled-support/SLA testing is deferred. Neither is a passing test. The scenarios remain documented for later work; literal stop retirement and fresh-session continuation remain required for this change. Both Preview support flags stay false. Read-only Production configuration showed intake enabled and follow-ups disabled; this is configuration evidence, not a scheduled run.

## Every slice

| Scenario | Action and required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Slack Q&A | Ask a simple question. It answers without tools or delegation when unnecessary; no approval card or duplicate final reply. |
| Billing and Intercom triage | Run a read-only billing case and a separate Intercom case. Confirm actual bounded provider reads, unavailable versus empty handling, customer-safe reply, and a clickable existing ticket link where one exists. In a negative control asking only what the skill does, perform no provider reads. |
| Linear investigation and critic | Investigate a selected test ticket read-only, including evidence-based product routing and memory access where authorized. Confirm critic dispatch, independent read-only evidence checks, and a returned verdict. An unknown ticket must return not found. |
| Attached image | Attach a non-sensitive test screenshot to the triggering mention without giving away its contents. Confirm staged attachment path, actual vision dispatch in the shared sandbox, and a correct answer. Also check an authenticated Linear-hosted image and a missing-image request without claiming to have read it. |
| Intake-only Slack | Verify the Preview channel's intake-only environment membership, then ask a repository question and a controlled delivery request. It may prepare/read the repository, investigate, comment, and file allowed work; root push_branch, the same tool inherited by a native child, and GitHub createPullRequest remain denied. Native delegation must not bypass these restrictions. |
| Repository selection | Give a bare owner/repo and ask which file controls GitHub visibility. Confirm prepare_repository selects it and the next step exposes the catalog. A path such as channels/github.ts with no repository request must not bind a repository. |
| Two native delegates | Ask for two independent read-only sandbox tasks through native agent, each with a complete prompt. Confirm two distinct child sessions/call IDs, working receipts, shared sandbox access, successful child action results and the later parent reply using both settled results. Send another user request while the children work and exercise a second delegation round; requests must remain accounted for and later results must match their original tasks. Separately verify one harmless Executor read from a native child using the deployed app auth. For a delegated support evidence task, inspect actual child actions and confirm it never calls support_investigation for any action, including open, track-issue, or finish; the parent owns that investigation. |
| Queue and stop, serial | Start bounded work, send a second mention while it runs, and confirm both requests remain accounted for. In a separate native-delegation run, send literal stop while a child is active; test both an active parent and a parent waiting on children. Confirm the exact session is retired through native reset, one idempotent "Stop requested." keyed by the retired session ID, actual root/child settlement and no later root wakeup, writes or stale progress. Reset acceptance alone does not prove these outcomes. A subsequent message must create a fresh internal session in the same Slack thread, recovering bounded visible history without hidden notes, tool results or sandbox state. A missing session or `no_active_session` stays quiet; a parked session is retired. A longer phrase such as stop the deploy remains normal input. Record acknowledgement latency. |
| Progress and final reply | Exercise a turn long enough to pass 5 minutes, and 15 minutes when available. Confirm each progress line appears at most once, status remains useful, and neither progress nor stale status appears after final completion, failure, or cancellation. |
| Fresh internal Slack session | Retire a drained test session and reply in the same Slack thread. Verify a new Eve session, earlier visible messages through the last bot reply and native later-message context without duplicating the triggering message. Cover a new thread, no prior bot reply, existing session, history above 32,000 characters, more than 50 replies and failed history reads. Whole-message truncation and incomplete/unavailable notices must be accurate; historical repository URLs or requests cannot establish new authority. Do not claim hidden results or sandbox files were restored. |
| Slack rendering | On the exact Preview deployment, reproduce a PR URL followed by a newline and Branch text before considering a custom renderer. |
| GitHub mentions only | On a scratch repo, a trusted mention starts a signed repository-bound session. Label, PR-open, check/CI, review, and synchronize events produce no new session, automatic PR summary, or stabilization work. An untrusted mention does not dispatch. |
| Direct scratch delivery, serial | Use an explicit scratch repo and existing test Linear ticket. Request a tiny README change, checks, feature branch, and normal PR. Verify exact pushed diff and check results, ticket link, and no merge. Clean up only these identified test resources after evidence is recorded. |

## Commands and runtime proof

Load `.env.example`, then run `pnpm validate`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm verify:built-github`, and `pnpm report:capabilities`. `pnpm build` warms sandbox templates and also needs a linked `.vercel/` project and `VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN`; `.env.example` alone fails on a fresh copy. Root and critic each retain their intended connections; the compiled declared children are exactly critic and vision. The manifest must be version 54; the report must use compiled owner bindings to exclude framework defaults and actual prepared critic/vision schemas. All 31 GitHub tools must survive the built-artifact durable callback validator in all three phases: execute, approvalRequest and toModelOutput. The proof boots the server, reads its registered compiled module map (the extension is inlined in 0.81.1), checks both omitted lanes and the admitted repository lane, distinguishes the two approval policies and rejects an unstamped callback. Do not substitute `eve info` for that proof.

Run `pnpm eval --tag fast`, `pnpm eval routing/native-delegation` and `pnpm eval safety/model-swap-parks` against the exact Preview deployment (`--url`), and the opt-in `routing/direct-scratch-repository` with `FOREMAN_SCRATCH_REPO` and `FOREMAN_SCRATCH_TICKET`. The browser-smoke eval is gone. The judge model is pinned in `evals/evals.config.ts` to the `typesafe-ai/jev` Gateway decision model; never set a Claude id as the judge. The scratch repo must have a `main` base branch. Use the Eve local-dev or Vercel OIDC eval principal without a Foreman trust stamp; the eval requires exactly one push approval and verifies its branch and repository before approving. The native-delegation eval must correlate each child's agent stream, task result and action result with its call ID within the held parent turn; working receipts do not satisfy the final-result assertion. Its bounded timeout cleanup calls `session.cancel()`, which cancels background tasks as well as the parent. Record any unavailable runtime checks plainly; do not count skipped checks as passing.

## Scheduled support, when affected

Keep Preview support disabled unless a separate Preview database/queue, migrations, selected synthetic conversations, handoff app identity, support toolkit, and fixed Slack destination are explicitly verified. Live scheduled-support acceptance is deferred for ENG-13737 by Aaron; the following checks remain for a later authorized run. Check an intake and follow-up through the real scheduled identity, including critic/vision and journaled allowed Linear writes. The first intake queues and attempts one concise Slack result; uncertain deliveries remain for reconciliation, so successful or exactly-once delivery is not guaranteed. Unchanged follow-ups stay quiet. A premature parent completion must not release the lease or mark an unfinished investigation successful. Disabling the master flag and deploying it prevents later work; verify the active revision.

Exercise the support lifecycle on isolated synthetic cases: parent text before child completion, two delegation rounds, explicit finish after critic adjudication, root turn failure and terminal session failure, a child failure that leaves the root lease intact, prohibited input/authorization waits, 150 total root steps across turns with retries deduplicated, deadline expiry, late results after settlement and an expired first-intake lease. The latter must post the incomplete notice on the next scheduled claim, leave investigation for another check, and suppress an identical repeated notice. Pending outboxes must reconcile first, including a lost Slack response. Reclaimed unchanged follow-ups remain quiet. Also let a follow-up root return without calling support_investigation: its active lease must block intervening ticks, expiry permits a new claim, and neither a report nor a processed-version update may be invented. This case retries at the lease cadence and has no lifetime retry cap. Run the real disposable PostgreSQL store harness when these paths change. These tests do not authorize customer product, billing or Intercom mutations.

## Eve upgrade cutover and rollback rehearsal

Complete this rehearsal on Preview before Production acceptance of any eve upgrade. The current runbook and evidence are in [EVE-0832-UPGRADE.md](./EVE-0832-UPGRADE.md) (0.81.1 to 0.83.2); [EVE-0811-UPGRADE.md](./EVE-0811-UPGRADE.md) holds the drain-and-reset cutover used when sessions cannot cross. Build success and `eve info` do not show whether sessions cross; only this rehearsal does.

1. Rehearsal branch. Use a dedicated Preview branch such as `qa/<ticket>-handoff`, not a PR branch. Copy the branch-scoped Preview env from the last tested branch (`LINEAR_CONNECTOR`, `EXECUTOR_*`, `FOREMAN_MEMORY_DATABASE_URL`, plus anything else the rows need), record the Preview Slack and Linear connector trigger destinations, and point both at the branch with an atomic `trigger-destinations` PATCH; read back exactly one destination each. Prove the build for every message: deployment `meta.githubCommitSha`, and the run's `deploymentId` and `$eve.version` from `npx workflow inspect runs`.
2. Old sessions. Deploy the current `main` with its warm snapshot set branch-scoped. Start a Slack thread that states a fact and writes a file in the sandbox, a Slack thread that uses two native delegates, and a Linear Agent Session on a team SAN ticket. Record each session id.
3. Forward continuation. Set branch-scoped `VERCEL_SANDBOX_BASE_SNAPSHOT_ID` to an empty string before pushing the upgrade head and redeploying (deleting it falls back to the general Preview snapshot). Record the resulting deployment, then continue each session. It passes when the continuation run names the original session in `$eve.session`, runs the new `$eve.version` on the new deployment, recalls the fact, reads the file back from its existing sandbox and makes a new tool call. Any fresh session, failure or lost sandbox means the Production cutover drains and resets instead.
4. Warm snapshot. Run `rebuild_warm_snapshot` from an attended session on the new deployment, set its id branch-scoped, redeploy, and run a sandbox command in a fresh session. A snapshot from another eve image fails every session at sandbox start.
5. Rollback. With upgraded sessions open, pause both triggers and session-starting schedules, let active work finish and follow the full paginated inventory in [EVE-0832-UPGRADE.md](./EVE-0832-UPGRADE.md). Before the reset loop, name one synthetic upgraded session to retain; reset every other upgraded session through its owning upgraded deployment host (`/eve/v1/session/:sessionId/reset`). Exempt only that named session from the rehearsal's reset reconciliation gate, push `main` back with the old snapshot, and verify the serving alias and health. Observe the retained session after the revert and record what it does (on 0.83.2 it kept answering on the old deployment), then reset it and run the full reconciliation before restoring triggers and schedules. After restoration, continue each thread: each starts a fresh session with visible history. Production rollback gates remain unchanged.
6. Restore. Put both triggers back on their recorded destinations, read them back, and remove the rehearsal branch's env.

Also confirm these behaviors on the exact Preview deployment:

| Case | Expected result |
| --- | --- |
| Long `bash` command | A command still running after 30 seconds returns `status: "running"` with its output so far, and the model continues, reading the output files with later commands instead of hanging the turn. |
| Approved call identity | An approved call runs as the requester, never the approver. No approval card appears on Slack or Linear; Foreman's gates deny instead of parking. |
| Model stream timeout | A model stream silent for ten minutes is abandoned and retried; when retries run out the turn ends with a terminal `turn.failed`, which posts exactly one failure notice and no double post. |

The upgrade requires Aaron's acceptance and explicit merge approval before Production. Browser build/typecheck/unit success and local store tests are separate evidence from this live battery. Record unrun cases as outstanding unless Aaron explicitly waived or deferred them, and preserve that distinction.

Production is deployed from main. Regressions are undone by reverting the slice on main; never use vercel rollback. Aaron accepts one PR before the next opens.
